message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Quick Overview)** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round and by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card (e.g., Draw Two, Skip, Reverse, Wild), follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• **Wild** cards can be played at any time; you declare the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** can only be played if you have no playable card of the current color (otherwise you risk a challenge). | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip (+1)** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse (+1)** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild (+1)** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+1)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Game End** | The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. | | **No Challenge** | Wild Draw Four can be played freely without the risk of being challenged. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) with different mechanics. | **Key Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. 3. Remember to call “UNO” loudly and clearly! Enjoy playing Uno!
